description: This file defines extension methods for configuring Azure Table transactional state storage in Orleans silo builders, enabling easy setup of Azure Table Storage as the default or specific transactional grain storage.

classes.name: AzureTableTransactionSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring Azure Table transactional storage in Orleans silo builders.

methods.name: AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage as the default transactional grain storage, with options specified via a configuration action.

methods.name: AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage for transactional grain storage with a specified name and options.

methods.name: AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorageAsDefault (overload)
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage as the default transactional grain storage, with optional configuration via OptionsBuilder.

methods.name: AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage (overload)
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table Storage for transactional grain storage with a specified name and optional configuration.
